zagg - xtr6 screen protector with blue l.name: ZAGG - XTR6 Screen Protector with Blue Light Filter for Apple iPhone 18 Pro / iPhone 17 Pro - Clear
zagg - xtr6 screen protector with blue l.description: Can a screen protector actually make your phone better? Yes it can! ZAGG's XTR6 for Apple iPhone 18 Pro & iPhone 17 Pro is our most technologically advanced screen protector, actually removes microscopic imperfections in its glass for an amazingly strong, smooth surface. It’s been tested up to 22x stronger than basic glass screen protection! XTR6 also helps you sleep better and wake up restored with Eyesafe CPF70 technology that has been scientifically validated by SleepScore Labs and objectively shown to improve sleep quality. In addition to unbeatable strength and blue light filtration, XTR6 features anti-reflective technology that ensures color depth and vibrancy on your screen. Its incredibly smooth, touch-sensitive surface is perfect for gamers. XTR6 also has an anti-dust adhesive and the easy PerfectFit installation process. At ZAGG, we’re conscious of our environmental impact, so XTR6 is made with up to 30% recycled glass, and our packaging is 100% recyclable.
